annotations.title: Air quality now + 24h peak (US AQI, PM2.5, PM10, ozone)

description: [Kyreos, 0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Live air quality for any latitude/longitude: current US AQI and category, PM2.5, PM10, ozone, and the next-24h peak AQI with its hour. Same inputs as weather forecast. Example: latitude=52.52&longitude=13.41. Input: latitude=52.52&longitude=13.41. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/air-quality-now?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.01 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.
